title: Slow English Podcast #300: Al Ain - BAE

sentences.text: one. Welcome to the slow English podcast. My name is Emili. In this podcast, we speak
slowly. We use easy English. We repeat words many times. Today, we travel to the Middle
East. We go to the United Arab Emirates. Our city today is Al Ain. Al Ain is calm. Al
Ain is green. Al Ain is full of history and tradition. Please relax. Please listen
slowly. Let's begin our journey together. Part two, the United Arab Emirates. The
United Arab Emirates is a country in the Middle East. People also say UAE. The UAE
has deserts. The UAE has modern cities. The UAE has old traditions. Many people know
Dubai. Many people know Abu Dhabi. But today, we visit Al Ain. Al Ain is different. Al
Ain is quiet and traditional. Part three, where is Al Ain? Al Ain is in the east of
the UAE. It is near the border with Oman. The city is not on the sea. It is in the desert
area. But Al Ain has water. Al Ain has trees. Because of this, people call it the garden
city. The city feels fresh and open. Part four, weather and climate. Al Ain has a hot climate.
In summer, it is very hot. The sun is strong. In winter, the weather is warm. Days are sunny
and pleasant. Rain is rare. People live with the sun and heat. Life moves slowly because of the
weather. Part five, a city with long history. Al Ain is one of the oldest cities in the UAE.
People lived here thousands of years ago. The city was important for travel and trade.
Water made life possible here. History is under the ground. History is in old buildings.
Al Ain is a city of the past and present. Part six, oasis and water. Al Ain is famous for its oasis.
And oasis is a green place in the desert. Palm trees grow here. Water flows quietly.
People walk in the shade. They feel cool and calm. The oasis gives life. The oasis gives peace.
Asha, part seven, Al Ain oasis. The Al Ain oasis is very famous. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Old water systems bring water to plants. These systems are very smart. People learn about old life
here. They understand desert culture. The oasis shows balance between nature and people.
Part eight, mountains and nature near Al Ain. There are mountains. One mountain is called Jibel
Haft. People drive to the top. They look at the city from above. The view is wide. The land looks
calm and strong. Nature is part of daily life in Al Ain. Part nine, daily life in Al Ain.
Daily life in Al Ain is peaceful. People wake up early. They work and study. They spend time
with family. In the evening, people go outside. They walk and talk. Life is not fast. Life feels
balanced and calm. Part 10, food and traditions. Food in Al Ain is traditional. People eat rice,
meat and bread. Dates are very important. They are sweet and healthy. People eat together.
Family is very important. Food brings people close. Part 11, culture and people. People in Al Ain
are friendly. They respect tradition. Clothes show culture. Language shows history. Visitors feel
welcome. People smile and help. Culture is strong and alive. Part 12, feeling spirit and goodbye.
Al Ain is a city of desert, water, history and calm life. It is quiet. It is green. It is full
of soul. Al Ain shows another side of the UAE. It shows tradition and peace.
